text: I'm someone who's terrified of teeth cleaning and hates going to the dentist because I've had tooth sensitivity since I was a child. But coming here was a whole new world! Dental procedures aren't scary anymore. I asked for local anesthesia because I can't tolerate the pain, and the dentist happily obliged. They were incredibly kind and provided excellent service, from making an appointment to arriving on time. I didn't have to wait long, and the dentist was so kind, spoke so well, listened to all my concerns, and didn't rush me. They gave me plenty of time to rest between treatments. The staff were all welcoming, and the clinic was spotlessly clean. I was extremely impressed. Dental health shouldn't be neglected. I highly recommend trying this clinic; you'll overcome your fear of dental work once and for all.

text:
...I went to consult about correcting my appointment slip, saying that I could come back next time to discuss the treatment plan with the doctor. However, on my second visit, I felt like my medical history hadn't been updated. I had to inform the doctor that I wanted metal braces, as the information from the admin might be inaccurate. The doctor was very kind and said it was okay, which was good that I informed them beforehand; otherwise, I would have had to send my information abroad to get dental impressions.

In short, if you use their services, you might need to discuss many things directly with the doctor, or ask many questions.

This also includes the payment process, as I mentioned using social security insurance, but they didn't process the payment.

This might seem like a minor issue, but overall, I agreed to have them take care of my orthodontic treatment and receive care here anyway.
